torat-emet.title: Torat Emet
torat-emet.desc: Rabbi Yehudah Leib (Leibele) Eiger of Lublin, disciple of the Mei HaShiloach: discourses on the Torah (Bereishis through Devarim) and the festivals, gathered by his son. Complete interlinear edition in three volumes, with source notes, parallels and Sefaria links.

imrei-emet.title: Imrei Emet
imrei-emet.desc: Rabbi Yehudah Leib (Leibele) Eiger of Lublin's Shabbos and festival discourses on the Torah, with Likkutei Amarim and the Kuntres Acharon (Lublin 1902-1903). Complete interlinear edition with source notes, parallels and Sefaria links.

sod-yesharim.title: Sod Yesharim
sod-yesharim.desc: Rabbi Gershon Henoch Leiner of Radzin on the Torah and the festivals, Rosh Hashanah through Pesach. Complete interlinear edition in two parts, with source notes, parallels and Sefaria links; the festival sections keep the os numbers of the earlier edition.
